facts.business: Aksh Optifibre Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of optical fibre, optical fibre cables, and related products.

auditor.name: M/s P.C. Bindal & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-recognition of provision for interest (Rs 2,146.35 lakhs) and cenvatable duty (Rs 840.19 lakhs) under Advance Authorization and EPCG schemes. Emphasis of Matter on foreign currency payables/receivables outstanding beyond regulatory timelines, SARFAESI notices from Union Bank of India (Rs 4,973 lakhs) and HDFC Bank (Rs 3,663 lakhs), and misalignment of UBI outstanding balance.

key_risks: Company admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) by NCLT Jaipur Bench order dated June 19, 2026
Non-recognition of provisions for interest and duty liabilities aggregating Rs 2,986.54 lakhs contrary to Ind AS 37
Foreign currency payables (Rs 26.79 lakhs >6 months, Rs 1,569.68 lakhs >3 years) and receivables (Rs 4,362.95 lakhs >15 months) outstanding beyond regulatory timelines
SARFAESI proceedings by Union Bank of India (claim Rs 4,973 lakhs) and HDFC Bank (claim Rs 3,663 lakhs)
Misalignment of Union Bank of India outstanding balance due to inappropriate adjustment of cutback and simple interest provisioning
